messages:
emily-marketing: Hey team — final draft of the launch post is up in the drive. Quick sync: need legal quick-pass on claims, design variants for CTAs, and confirmation of HubSpot form mapping for webinar registrants. Goal: publish tomorrow AM.

sam-growth: copying in UTM plan + quick CTA suggestion: register -> utm_source=launch_blog&utm_campaign=launch_may; try -> utm_source=launch_blog&utm_campaign=try_now. keep short. :+1:

raja-product: quick Q on benchmarks — where are we sourcing the numbers? we should avoid superlatives. can we say "up to 2.5x lower per-token cost vs baseline" and link methodology?

kevin-legal: Noted. please add source links for each quantitative claim. avoid "industry‑leading" or "best" unless we have a third‑party study. I can greenlight phrasing like: "reduced per-token cost by up to 2.5x in our internal benchmark" if methodology is included.

olivia-design: Two hero variants ready: 1) product-in-use photo with CTA buttons stacked, 2) illustration with inline CTAs. Which CTAs do we wire: [Register Webinar] and [Try Hosted API]? Need sizes for social.

emily-marketing: Excerpt of hero copy we plan to use: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower inference costs. Join our launch webinar to see live demos — or try Redwood now." CTAs: Register Webinar / Try Redwood. UTM for register: ?utm_source=launch_blog&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=launch_may_register

publish-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/launch-post-5487654321 (staging). Snapshot created by publish-bot at 5487654360.

sam-growth: For HubSpot mapping — use existing form id 0a3f4c, map hidden field `source=launch_blog` and push `webinar_segment=early_access` for registrants who click Register. Also add slack notify to #sales-inbound when form submits.

emily-marketing: @sam-growth doing that now. @kevin-legal I added a short methodology doc in the draft (drive link). it lists HW (p4d), batch sizes, models compared.

raja-product: methodology quick note: latency and token-cost measured on p4d with batch=4, sequence=1024, steady-state window after warmup. sample command we used for perf: 
```
./run_benchmark --model redwood-1.0 --seq 1024 --batch 4 --warmup 50 --measure cost,latency
```

kevin-legal: Thanks. I looked at the doc. Approve the numeric claim if you change wording to: "In our internal benchmark (p4d, batch=4), Redwood reduced per-token inference cost by up to 2.5x compared to the baseline model. See methodology." Also add the drive link in a footnote on the post. Once that's in, I sign off.

emily-marketing: Updated copy to match legal and added drive link. Also updated CTAs and UTMs in the draft. Assigning owners: design -> olivia, legal -> kevin, growth -> sam (forms + slack), engineering -> raja (benchmark appendix).

olivia-design: I can push alt images + social banners by EOD. Will upload 1200x628 and 800x800.

sam-growth: I'll config the hidden fields and slack webhook now, will ping when done. :rocket:

emily-marketing: Thanks all — locking copy at 2:00pm PT unless anyone objects. If you need copy tweaks speak now.

sam-growth: 👍

kevin-legal: approved in thread.

raja-product: LGTM on wording.

olivia-design: uploading assets in ~3h.

emily-marketing: Perfect — final publish checklist: 1) legal tag on post 2) form mapping verified 3) preview ok 4) social assets uploaded. Will call publish window at 10am PT tomorrow.
